description: This file defines the 'AppState' class, which is responsible for managing application state, configuration, and settings for a macOS app. It includes state variables, persistence logic, configuration loading and synchronization, and external system integrations. The class also supports previewing and testing modes.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Class managing the application's persistent state, configurations, and runtime behaviors for OpenClaw on macOS.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructor initializing application state, loading persisted settings, and setting up configuration watcher.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads configuration from disk and applies overrides.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Applies configuration overrides from a given dictionary.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes the configuration with the external gateway, if needed.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates listening ears for a specified TTL.

methods.name: blinkOnce
methods.description: Triggers a visual blink in the UI.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality asynchronously.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode asynchronously.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets the global voice wake triggers and suppresses automatic sync.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync of voice wake triggers if not suppressed.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a chime configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Saves a chime configuration to user defaults.
